flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/ManageTemplate/form/EditTemplateForm.tsx (type LETTER uses the same editor), App.tsx (route edit-template/letter), page/ManageTemplate.tsx (tabs only SMS and Email), utils/mapping/ManageTemplate/ManageTemplateMap.ts. ocmsadminapi OcmsTemplateStoreController (accepts templateType LETTER). ocmsadminprivateapi toppan/upload/helpers/AnLetterPdfService + ToppanUploadHelper (AN letter PDF from template AN_LETTER for the Toppan batch). No template QR code in any of the six repos. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)', demo remark 'Upload not yet'. The generic edit form already accepts type LETTER and the backend accepts templateType LETTER, but the screen has no letter tab/menu and EditTemplateForm throws an error when opened without state from the list, so an officer cannot reach a letter template through the UI. QR code upload does not exist: the words qr/qrcode/zxing do not appear in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui ocmseserviceapi or thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep, 0 results; ocmseserviceui only has a PayNow QR on the payment page, PaymentSearchResult.ts:502, unrelated to templates); the imageUpload button in the editor toolbar is a generic editor feature and its upload handler is not visible in the repo. Sample PDF generation does not exist: the only letter PDF builder is AnLetterPdfService for template AN_LETTER in the Toppan batch, with no preview or download trigger from the staff portal. No maintenance ticket concerns letter templates.
recommendation: Do not claim in full. Only the generic text edit form exists and it is not reachable for letters; QR upload and sample PDF are not built (matches the demo remark 'Upload not yet'). Ask URA to confirm scope

steps.step: Officer selects a letter template to amend
steps.detail: Tabs are only SMS and Email (ManageTemplate.tsx:39-44). The route /enotification/edit-template/letter exists (App.tsx:283-286) but no letter list navigates to it, and EditTemplateForm destructures location.state directly (EditTemplateForm.tsx:228-229), so opening the URL without state throws an error. Same fact as the letter browse step in OCMS36.1.

steps.step: Officer edits the letter template text
steps.detail: For types other than SMS the edit form shows a Subject field and a rich editor (EditTemplateForm.tsx:156-202). For LETTER the content is sent as-is as templateContent (ManageTemplateMap.ts:222-227) and the backend accepts templateType LETTER (OcmsTemplateStoreController.java:211). The code exists but can only be reached when the page is given state (see previous step). The Subject field is not saved for letters (only EMAIL merges the subject, ManageTemplateMap.ts:222-227).

steps.step: Officer uploads a QR code to embed in the letter
steps.detail: There is no QR code handling in any repo (grep qr/qrcode/zxing in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi: 0 results). The editor toolbar has a generic imageUpload button (EditTemplateForm.tsx:196) but no upload adapter or endpoint exists in the repo and there is no QR placeholder; the upload handler cannot verify from repo. Matches the demo remark 'Upload not yet'.

steps.step: Officer generates a sample PDF of the amended letter
steps.detail: The only letter PDF builder is AnLetterPdfService.generateAnLetterPdf: it reads template AN_LETTER, fills notice placeholders, then OpenHTML2PDF (AnLetterPdfService.java:22,36-57,72-75), called from the Toppan batch per notice (ToppanUploadHelper.java:371). There is no endpoint or staff portal button to build a sample PDF from the template being edited. A generic mechanism exists but it is not the feature the story names.

steps.step: Officer downloads the revised PDF to review
steps.detail: There is no download button or PDF download endpoint on the template screen: the edit screen actions are only Back and Update (EditTemplateForm.tsx:90-97) and the list action is only View (TemplateList.tsx:177-187). Depends on the PDF generate step, which does not exist.
